paragraphs: Rabbah bar Yirmeyah. R' Zeira said that Rabbah bar Yirmeyah said: Berakhot 43a; Ketubbot 109a. R' Zeira said that Rabbah bar Yirmeyah said that Shmuel said: Pesahim 36a; Mo'ed Katan 4a; Gittin 74a; Niddah 11b. When R' Zeira came to Sura, he found Rabbah bar Yirmeyah speaking in Rav's name: Avodah Zarah 16b. R' Zeira said that R' Assi said that Rabbah bar Yirmeyah said that Rav Hama bar Gurya said in Rav's name: there. He came to Rav Yosef bar Abba's place: Avodah Zarah 50b. In Avodah Zarah 50b, Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi addresses Ravina bar Yirmeyah. Maharsha proposes reading the addressee as Rabbah bar Yirmeyah. Yuhasin records a teaching that Abba bar Yirmeyah reported in Shmuel’s name. R' Abba in his name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot chapter 5, Mishnah 2, and last chapter of Rosh Hashanah, halakhah 6. Rava in his name: Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot chapter 11. Perhaps they are one.
